purpose: A chip that shows the open vault and, on a tap, lists the vaults the person reaches, own first and shared ones labelled, and hands back the one they pick.
namedChanges: 0.1.1. new, additive: `useVaultChoice({ listed, ownVaultId, principal, appKey, represents?, store? })`, the state behind the chip (options, current, switchTo, markGone, canWrite; the choice kept per person and app); peer vault-list is now ^0.1.4 (it uses vaultsOfType, rememberVault, rememberedVault, forgetVault)

library.title: Vault switcher (a chip with the open vault and a sheet to pick another)
library.note: A chip with the open vault's name; a tap opens a sheet listing the vaults the person reaches, own first, shared and view-only ones labelled, the open one marked, and calls onPick with the chosen vault. React, on modal-sheet and vault-list (vaultChoices, choiceLine). It lists with the load you pass; the list itself is reachable-vaults or signin's listVaults. Also found as: vault chooser; choose a vault; pick another vault; switch between shared vaults; switch vault; several vaults; shared with me; vault picker. The hook useVaultChoice({ listed, ownVaultId, principal, appKey, represents?, store? }) holds the choice for you: options (own first), current, switchTo, markGone and canWrite, remembered per person and app, a gone vault dropped.
